name: Lawyer
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve black/gold tailored suit and long coat, glasses, gold accessories, polished shoes, fist briefcase and plain document. Review one expanding briefcase, gavel catch topology, client charm visibility, title legibility and stable face.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Lawyer — Objection.
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned man with short shaped black twists, neat goatee, black rectangular glasses with gold temples, charcoal tailored three-piece suit, long black coat with patterned gold lining, white shirt, black-and-gold tie with tie bar, gold pocket square and wristwatch, polished black shoes with gold fist buckles. Preserve his black hard briefcase with gold hardware and large gold FIST emblem in his left hand and one ivory document in his right.
0–0.7s: establish full body. A small gold fist charm hovers beside him as a symbolic client. Far above it, an absurdly enormous dark wooden gavel with brass bands plunges down. He looks up once, lifts the plain document and thrusts it forward with absolute confidence.
0.7–2.5s: on that document thrust, the gigantic gavel stops abruptly a few inches from the little client charm. His left arm swings the briefcase forward and snaps it open; camera pulls way back as the SAME briefcase expands to the size of a freight container. The falling gavel drops into its velvet-lined interior. He closes the huge briefcase with one gigantic authoritative CLAP, containing the entire gavel and launching a bounded gold/ivory impact star. The little client charm stays safe and shines brightly beside his shoulder. Briefcase is a finite foreground prop with cyan margins; no courtroom, desk, judge, floor or full-screen black wipe.
2.5–3.5s: the closed briefcase compresses instantly back to its ordinary size in his left hand. Camera snap-zooms to his completely unruffled face as exact title OBJECTION slams across the lower composition in one huge stable comic word.
3.5–5s: full-body professional hero hold, coat lining settling. He opens the case one inch; a tiny harmless wooden gavel pops out and lands neatly on his document. He gives it a unimpressed glance, folds the paper over it like a receipt and closes the case with a small click. Preserve two correct hands and his glasses. SFX: descending gavel whistle, sharp suspended-air stop, huge briefcase hinge whoosh, overwhelming decisive CLAP, compressing leather creak, title slam, tiny gavel tap and latch click. No spoken objection, narration, music or extra document text.
